title: Special-Order Cancellation Terms — Ship-To Fulfillment Account
content:
A special-order (non-stock) line booked on a Ship-To Fulfillment Account has a free cancellation period counted in full hours after the line was booked, and a cancellation fee for a cancellation made after that period. Both figures follow the service level of the ship-to.

| Service level | Free cancellation period (full hours after booking) | Cancellation fee after the free period (percent of the line's extended amount) |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 24 | 25 |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 24 | 25 |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | 24 | 20 |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 48 | 20 |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 48 | 15 |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 72 | 15 |

**Definitions**

- *Free cancellation period* — the full hours after booking within which a special-order line may be cancelled with no fee.
- *Cancellation fee* — the cancellation fee, percent of the line's extended amount, for a special-order line cancelled after the free period.

**Comparison across levels**

| Free period | Levels |
|---|---|
| 24 hours | Corbett Parcel Ship-To, Corbett Standard Ship-To, Corbett Priority Ship-To |
| 48 hours | Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To |
| 72 hours | Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To |

The percentage falls from 25 at the two lowest levels to 20 at Corbett Priority Ship-To and Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To and 15 at the two highest levels.
